title: Best Buy to host late-night openings for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time launch
summary: Everything gamers need to know ahead of the release.
body_markdown:
By[Best Buy](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/)


October 8, 2026


**Key Highlights**


- **Pre-order now:**[The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/video-game-franchises/the-legends-of-zelda/pcmcat1620057435002.c?id=pcmcat1620057435002) pre-orders are available now in stores, online or through the Best Buy app.


- **Late-night openings:** Pick up your order starting at midnight ET (Nov. 5) at nearly all U.S. stores, with openings at 11 p.m. CT, 10 p.m. MT and 9 p.


m. PT, 8 p.m. AKT, and 6 p.m. HT on Nov. 4.


The countdown to Hyrule is nearly over. To help fans celebrate


[The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/video-game-franchises/the-legends-of-zelda/pcmcat1620057435002.c?id=pcmcat1620057435002) *,* one of the most anticipated game launches of the year, nearly all Best Buy stores will open at midnight ET on Nov. 5 so customers can get their hands on the title the moment it’s available.


Best Buy stores will also have a limited number of[The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition Switch 2 System](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/switch-2-the-legend-of-zelda-40th-anniversary-edition/J7GSL57HTY/sku/6691841) , *c* opies of the game and[The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition Switch 2 Pro Controller](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/nintendo-switch-2-pro-controller-the-legend-of-zelda-40th-anniversary-edition-multi/J7GSL57W27) available for purchase.


## **Plan the launch-night adventure**


Here’s everything gamers need to know ahead of the release:


- **Pre-orders are available now:** Customers can pre-order


[The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/video-game-franchises/the-legends-of-zelda/pcmcat1620057435002.c?id=pcmcat1620057435002) now in stores, online or through the Best Buy app.


- **Take advantage of in-store pickup** : Nearly all U.S. stores will open Nov. 5 at midnight ET — that means 11 p.m. CT, 10 p.m. MT and 9 p.m. PT on Nov. 4. Use our


[store locator tool](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/the-legends-of-zelda/the-legend-of-zelda-late-night-opening/pcmcat1790102955046.c?id=pcmcat1790102955046) to find the closest location to you.


- **How to pick up:** Already selected pickup for


*The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* ? Customers can visit a store during our late-night opening to grab their pre-orders. Customers will receive an email with the option to switch to store pickup.


*Ready to get gaming? Learn more about all things The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time*[here](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/video-game-franchises/the-legends-of-zelda/pcmcat1620057435002.c?id=pcmcat1620057435002) *.*
